personality.description: This person tends to follow curiosity wherever it leads, experimenting with new ideas, unusual angles, and original ways of doing things. At the same time, they are often loose with structure, acting on impulse, leaving tasks half-organized, and sometimes forgetting details or deadlines. In moral dilemmas, they usually try to understand multiple viewpoints and look for a creative compromise, but if a choice feels personally important, they can firmly defend their position. In group discussions, they speak thoughtfully and selectively, preferring quiet settings or small circles, and their words may become tense or hesitant when they are anxious or overthinking a problem.
